description: SHA512_STEP balanced-tree add reassociation (value-identical); -0.5% within noise -> ptxas already schedules add chain optimally; SHA-512 pure is latency/occupancy-bound at instr roofline (single-LOP3 Ch/Maj, minimal-SHF XOR3 sigmas, IADD3-fused steps, ~24 live u64 regs fix occupancy)

PRMT-offload byte-aligned rotr64(x,8) in SHA512_S2 msg-schedule (2 prmt.b32 on XU pipe vs 2 SHF on ALU): value-identical (selftest PASS) but -2.1% (2878.4 vs 2939.6). ncu(vec8) showed ALU top pipe (79.2%) but real vec1 config is latency/occupancy-bound (16.7% occ, reg-limited), not ALU-throughput-bound; asm-volatile prmt + u64<->2xu32 split adds MOVs and blocks ptxas funnel-shift fusion. Only 64 S2 uses (rounds 16-79). SHA-512 pure at instr roofline; SHF-offload does not help a latency-bound ARX chain (consistent with prior reassoc discard)

CUDA rotr64_S via explicit hc_funnelshift_r on u64 halves (vconv64_t union split, 2x shf.r.wrap.b32): value-identical (selftest PASS) but -73% (798.0 vs 2939.6). Union type-punning for the u64<->2xu32 split forces rotate operands through local memory and blocks ptxas native fusion of the (a>>n)|(a<<(64-n)) idiom into shf.wrap pairs; catastrophic across 80+ rotates/hash. Confirms ptxas already emits optimal SHF for 64-bit rotates -> SHA-512 rotate lowering is at roofline (consistent with PRMT-offload discard: explicit u64 half-splitting hurts a latency-bound ARX chain)

SHA512_EXPAND balanced-tree reassoc (S3+y)+(S2+w) on msg-schedule w-recurrence (value-identical, selftest PASS): 2931.0 vs 2939.6 = -0.3%, within noise. ptxas already reorders the u64 add tree optimally -> source-level associativity of EXPAND is a no-op (same lesson as prior STEP-reassoc discard, different code location). SHA-512 m1700 at instr/latency roofline: single-LOP3 Ch/Maj, funnel-shift XOR3 sigmas, IADD3-fused steps, 16-word rolling schedule already register-minimal; msg-schedule reassoc, PRMT-offload, and u64-half-split all discard. Roofline confirmed.

ROOFLINE DECLARED (no code change this round). Audited benchmark path m01700_a3-pure -> sha512_init/update/final_vector -> shared sha512_transform_vector (standard 80-round). Instr selection already minimal: Ch/Maj=bitselect=1 LOP3/word; sigmas S0-S3=3x hc_rotr64 XOR -> ptxas funnel-shift + LOP3 XOR3 (already fused, no Keccak-style XOR3 analog); STEP add-chain IADD3-fused; 16-word rolling EXPAND reg-minimal. Lever space exhausted by 4 prior principled discards: STEP reassoc -0.5% (ptxas no-op), EXPAND reassoc -0.3% (no-op), PRMT-offload S2 rotr8 -2.1%, explicit funnel-shift half-split -73%. Real config latency/occupancy-bound (16.7% occ, reg-limited), NOT ALU-throughput-bound; no critical-path or register lever remains that ptxas does not already apply. Dead-tail is a documented ptxas no-op and cannot be applied to the shared generic transform without breaking other consumers. m1700 SHA-512 at instruction/latency roofline; stop chasing 64-bit SHA-2 family.
